root_and_in_place_convention.preserve: Existing pelvis vertical bob and small in-place horizontal sway; no renamed bones, new ground root, rerig or animation-driven displacement.

idle_and_weapon_socket.space: Blender pose-bone HEAD matrix, centimeters; column-vector matrices
idle_and_weapon_socket.native_conversion: Verify source-to-native component basis C and native hand_r pose H at hold frame 1; native local socket = inverse(H) * C * source_rifle_component_matrix * inverse(C), using correct native transform multiplication. Do not copy Blender quaternion directly as an Unreal FRotator.
idle_and_weapon_socket.support_hand: Use authored pose. Rear handguard contact; do not force generic SupportHand=(31,0,2.4). Minor finger overlap and loose shoulder seat remain pilot-only.
idle_and_weapon_socket.pistol: Not fitted/approved. Do not reuse rifle two-hand hold/socket as a pistol fit. Preserve first-person behavior; retain existing remote P01 only if native inspection passes, otherwise unarmed/reference-pose fallback with remote pistol omitted and limitation recorded. Never show R01 during P01 equip.
idle_and_weapon_socket.weapon_scale_review: User finds current gun too large beside the character. Existing R01 is a temporary baseline only: full assembled envelope 86 x 9.04 x 32.2 cm at scale 1 beside a 170 cm character (length 50.6% of body height). Grip profile spans roughly -10 to 0.8 cm in X, 4.8 cm in Y, -13 to +3 cm in Z. Its bulky receiver/handguard and wide grip are not final visual approval. Do not rescale hands/character to compensate. ART-17/18 own separate replacement weapon source; native replacement requires a separate scheduled integration.
